spec.description: Screenshot capture pipeline stage telemetry (channel boxel:screenshot-perf): request records from the serving surfaces (realm-server) and capture records from the screenshot-card worker task, joined by jobId/correlationId. The same capture breakdown is persisted on media_cache_ledger.diagnostics for SQL reads.

panels.title: Capture-relevant requests (5m)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Requests on the two capture surfaces that touched capture work: hits, renders, 503s, 403s. Addressing 404s/400s never emit.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests by outcome

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" [$__interval]))

panels.description: hit = ledger hit with zero Chrome work; rendered = capture completed within the sync wait; timeout/congested = 503 + Retry-After; gated = 403.

panels.title: Request wall-clock (totalMs)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap totalMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap totalMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.99, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap totalMs [$__interval]) by ()

panels.description: What callers experienced end-to-end on the serving surfaces, all outcomes.

panels.title: Capture latency by stage (p95)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap queueWaitMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap permissionsMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap launchMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap renderMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap navMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap settleMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap screenshotMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap decodeMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap persistMs [$__interval]) by ()

panels.description: Where a capture's wall-clock goes, p95 per stage. queueWaitMs is enqueue→claim; launchMs is page acquire in the pool; renderMs is the server-observed render (nav/settle/imagePaint/screenshot are its components); persistMs is the MediaCache put.

panels.title: Queue wait vs render (p95)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap queueWaitMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap prerenderMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap renderMs [$__interval]) by ()

panels.description: A deep serialized lane shows as queue wait; a slow render shows on the render side.

panels.title: Page acquire by warm/cold tab (p95 launchMs)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap launchMs [$__interval]) by (tabReused)

panels.description: tabReused=false is the cold-start tax; true with a large launch is pool contention.

panels.title: Persist outcome

targets.expr: sum by (persistOutcome) (count_over_time({service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" [$__interval]))

panels.description: uploaded vs deduped (bytes already stored under the content key) vs skipped/failed.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap totalMs [$__interval]) by (realmURL)

panels.title: Request wall-clock p95 by surface

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap totalMs [$__interval]) by (surface)

panels.description: get-dsl is the GET _screenshot/ DSL route; post is POST /_screenshot-card.

targets.expr: topk(20, max by (sourceURL) (max_over_time({service=~"realm-server|worker", env="$env"} |= "boxel:screenshot-perf" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:screenshot-perf" | eventType="capture" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | surface=~"$surface" | unwrap totalMs [$__range])))
